name: M6.BoundaryFibers.kernel_iff
statement: ∀ (a b M : M6.BoundaryFibers.BP) (h : AdjoinRoot M), M6.BoundaryFibers.boundary a b M h = (0,0) ↔ AdjoinRoot.mk M (M6.Cyclic.signature a b M) * h = 0
queries: finite cardinality subtype equivalence fibers additive map
guidance: Represent h using AdjoinRoot.induction_on. map_mul and mk_eq_zero reduce both sides to accepted Cyclic.kernel_divisibility. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
